_comment: The F015 boundary: every variable an agent child inherits from the engine. A change here changes what untrusted code can read, so it is reviewed rather than merged quietly. Each entry records WHY it is safe — a name with no reason is the shape that lets the list grow one convenience at a time. Entries may also carry `constraints`, which are asserted at RUNTIME by the suite named in `checked_by`: membership is not safety, and a variable can be on this list and still point somewhere it must not.

allowed.PATH: where binaries live; the harness cannot run without it
allowed.LANG: locale; describes the machine, not the project
allowed.LC_ALL: locale; describes the machine, not the project
allowed.TZ: timezone; describes the machine, not the project
allowed.TMPDIR: scratch location; describes the machine, not the project
allowed.SSL_CERT_FILE: CA bundle — without it a private-CA container looks like a network fault
allowed.NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS: CA bundle for node-based harnesses, as above
allowed.RUSTUP_HOME: where the immutable shared toolchain lives; machine configuration, not a secret and not project-scoped. ADVERSARY 029 admits it ONLY under the image's read-only toolchain dir.

RUSTUP_HOME.why: A toolchain a child can WRITE is a toolchain a child can replace, and every later project builds with whatever it left there. Read-only and outside the data dir is what makes inheriting it safe; inheriting the NAME is not the safe part.

CARGO_HOME.why: What a tenant FETCHES is not immutable. A shared CARGO_HOME puts one project's downloaded sources — and any registry credentials it configures — where the next project can read them. Set per project at spawn, never inherited.

checked_by: qa/integration/test_wheel_on_wheel.py (WOW-toolchain-*), per PM: the WOW leg is the acceptance test

pending.RUSTUP_HOME: ADVERSARY 029 / PM ruling 2026-09-06: SDK adds this after ingress. Pinned ahead of the change so the review is on record BEFORE the code, not after. Expires by breaking: once the engine has it, this marker must go or the gate fails — a pending note that outlives its change is how a list starts lying.
